records.rationale: Vertical fader slider: a fully custom-styled native <input type="range"> (writing-mode rotation, custom thumb/track paint). D-05's 'Specialized surfaces... vertical faders... may own domain-specific visualization and input geometry' carve-out -- there is no slider/fader primitive anywhere else in this codebase to reuse.
records.reviewCondition: a shared slider/fader primitive is added to the design system

records.rationale: faderClearButton is fixed at 18x18px regardless of --ds-fader-width, which can resize down to FADER_WIDTH_MIN (18px) -- IconButton's smallest size (32px) and fixed 20px icon would overflow the column at that width and collide with the adjacent fader.
records.reviewCondition: IconButton grows a size tier at or below 18px total footprint

records.rationale: Same domain-geometry exception as desk-fader-clear-button-jsx (raw button, not IconButton, for FADER_WIDTH_MIN column-width reasons) -- this class is that button's own visual styling, not an independent decision to hand-roll shared button chrome.
Same domain-geometry exception as desk-fader-clear-button-jsx -- this is that same button's own hover state, not an independent decision.
Same domain-geometry exception as desk-fader-clear-button-jsx -- this fixed 18x18px button's own corner radius, not an independent spacing/radii decision.

The MIDI-learn click target: fully transparent, sized to the whole fader card (inset:0), sitting above the range input so a click in learn mode never doubles as a drag. Split into its own file so this is the only raw button the checker finds here (see this file's own header comment).
records.reviewCondition: a shared invisible-hit-area primitive is added to the design system

records.rationale: MetaBadge mirrors ProjectFixtures.tsx's own MetaTag convention -- duplicated locally rather than imported since there is no exported shared primitive, mirroring ArtnetConfig/FixturePatch's established 'small helper duplicated per feature' precedent (see MetaBadge's own doc comment in Desk.tsx).
records.reviewCondition: a shared MetaTag/MetaBadge primitive is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same MetaBadge exception as desk-badge-shared-class -- this is that same pill's own label text styling.
Same MetaBadge exception as desk-badge-shared-class -- this is that same pill's own value text styling.

Scales down with the row's own --ds-fader-width (Desk.tsx's per-row horizontal preset/resize) so a Compact/Normal-width row's badge still fits next to the fixture name on one line. The clamp() ceiling is the pre-migration fixed size -- a wide/Large/Fit row never grows past it, only shrinks at narrower ones. DS001 does not recognize clamp()/calc() as a token reference the way it does a bare var(--ds-*). match is this declaration's own distinguishing suffix, not its full value -- the checker mechanically rejects '*' in any match string, which the full clamp()/calc() text always contains.
records.reviewCondition: a fader-width-responsive typography token is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same fader-width-responsive exception as desk-badge-label-font-size -- this pill's own value text, not its label. Also a distinguishing suffix, not the full value, for the same '*'-is-forbidden reason.
Same fader-width-responsive exception as desk-badge-label-font-size -- the value badge above each fader track. Also a distinguishing suffix, not the full value, for the same '*'-is-forbidden reason.

This pill's own fixed 20px height is what actually centers its text -- line-height only needs to stay tight enough not to add its own extra leading above/below the glyph, which neither semantic line-height role (1.5 body/1.2 heading, both meant for ordinary paragraph/heading text) expresses.
records.reviewCondition: a 'tight'/1.0 line-height token is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same tight-line-height reasoning as desk-fader-value-line-height, for the numbered fader-scale ruler tick text (255/192/128/64/0) -- 1.1 rather than 1 only because this text isn't centered inside a fixed-height box the way .faderValue's pill is, so it has no exact-centering constraint pinning it to the identical value.

records.match: background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent calc(50% - 2px), var(--ds-border-default) calc(50% - 2px), var(--ds-border-default) calc(50% + 2px), transparent calc(50% + 2px))
records.rationale: Same domain-geometry exception as desk-fader-input (the custom vertical fader's own track-line paint -- see .faderInput's own doc comment). A custom-styled range input's thumb fills its full width by construction, so the thin track line is instead drawn via this background gradient rather than the (removed) native track rendering.

Matches this rule's own fixed 12px height so a 2-digit channel number centers inside its box instead of adding its own extra leading -- neither semantic line-height role is a fixed-pixel value compatible with a fixed-height single-line box like this one.
records.reviewCondition: a fixed-pixel line-height token is added to the design system

records.rationale: Ambient, looping 'invite to click' pulse for every still-unselected MIDI-learn target. --ds-motion-settle/-tap/-snap are all discrete one-shot UI feedback transitions (a state change finishing), not an ambient looping invitation -- no semantic-motion-token equivalent exists.
records.reviewCondition: an ambient/looping motion token is added to the design system

records.rationale: Colorless white overlay at low opacity, part of desk-fader-learn-target-pulse-animation's own keyframe -- deliberately white rather than a theme token so it lightens correctly regardless of theme (a light theme's own canvas is already pale, a dark theme's is not), never introducing a hue the surrounding card didn't already have. No --ds-surface-*/--ds-status-* option is colorless/theme-relative in this way.
records.reviewCondition: a theme-relative overlay token is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same colorless-white-overlay exception as desk-fader-learn-pulse-keyframe-rest -- this keyframe's own pulse peak (50%), not its rest state (0%/100%).

Same colorless-white-overlay exception as desk-fader-learn-pulse-keyframe-rest -- the static (non-pulsing), stronger step shown for the one channel actually being learned or in a conflict/timeout/error state.

Local stacking order within one fader's own small set of overlapping layers (pulse background below, hit area above it, badge above that in learn mode) -- unrelated to the app-wide --ds-stacking-* ladder, which coordinates sticky chrome/popovers/modals/the emergency overlay against each other, not sibling layers within one component's own stacking context.
records.reviewCondition: a local component-scoped stacking token is added to the design system

records.rationale: A native button's default focus outline would otherwise render right on top of the pulsing MIDI-learn background -- outline:none removes it, and the box-shadow-based focus-visible ring (desk-fader-learn-hit-area-focus-shadow) is the compensating visible focus indicator, a distinct visual layer from both outline and background-color.

The compensating visible focus ring for desk-fader-learn-hit-area-outline-none's outline:none -- box-shadow has no longhand decomposition, so this shorthand mixing raw geometry with a semantic color token can never satisfy DS001's bare-var()/calc(var()) pattern.
records.reviewCondition: a focus-ring box-shadow token is added to the design system

records.rationale: The always-visible 'this channel is MIDI-mapped' corner indicator -- a small, single-purpose decorative marker with no existing shared badge/chip primitive that fits a 14px absolute-positioned corner dot (Chip is a labeled status pill, not a bare dot).
records.reviewCondition: a shared corner-indicator-dot primitive is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same local-stacking exception as desk-fader-learn-hit-area-z-index -- this badge's own layer (above the pulse background, below the hit area outside learn mode).
Same corner-indicator-dot exception as desk-fader-learn-badge-shared-class -- this modifier makes the same dot clickable while learn mode is on.
Same corner-indicator-dot exception as desk-fader-learn-badge-shared-class -- this dot's own hover state while clickable.
Same corner-indicator-dot exception as desk-fader-learn-badge-shared-class -- this dot's own keyboard-focus state while clickable.
Same local-stacking exception as desk-fader-learn-hit-area-z-index -- this clickable dot's own topmost layer while learn mode is on.
